name: Journal of the American Chemical Society
canonical_title: Journal of the American Chemical Society
description: Premier global venue for fundamental discoveries across chemical sciences. Monitored strictly for high-impact macromolecular, supramolecular, and polymer chemistry breakthroughs.

name: Chemical Science
description: RSC's flagship diamond open access journal publishing findings of exceptional significance across chemical sciences, filtered for innovative polymer and macromolecular studies.

name: Macromolecules
description: The definitive benchmark journal for fundamental macromolecular research: polymer synthesis, living polymerization kinetics, polymer physics, self-assembly, and rheology.

name: Biomacromolecules
description: Primary journal for the interface of polymer science and biology: biomaterials, drug and gene delivery, polypeptides, polysaccharides, and stimuli-responsive smart bio-networks.

name: Polymer Chemistry
description: Leading RSC journal dedicated to innovative synthetic methodologies, living controlled radical polymerizations (ATRP, RAFT, CROP), and macromolecular architecture design.

name: Progress in Polymer Science
description: Top-ranked review journal in polymer science providing authoritative, critical reviews of state-of-the-art advances in polymer synthesis, physics, and bio-applications.

name: ACS Applied Polymer Materials
description: ACS journal focused on engineered polymers, functional coatings, polymer nanocomposites, separation membranes, and polymer electrolytes for energy applications.

name: Angewandte Chemie International Edition
description: One of the world's premier chemistry journals. Filtered strictly to track landmark discoveries in controlled living polymerizations, dynamic polymer networks, and macromolecular materials.

name: Small
description: Very high-impact micro- and nano-science journal, tracked specifically for polymeric nanocarriers, block copolymer lithography, polymer brushes, and nanostructured biomaterials.

name: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces
description: Leading ACS journal dedicated to functional materials and interfacial systems. Monitored strictly for polymer coatings, antifouling surfaces, hydrogel adhesives, and polymer composites.
